items.title: UK banks face higher profit levy under Healey's Budget
items.summary: According to BBC, the government has increased the bank profit surcharge to 6% to help finance energy bill support for households.

items.title: Budget outlines minimum wage rises and savings changes for young adults
items.summary: According to BBC, the government has confirmed a 3.9% minimum wage increase for 18 to 20-year-olds alongside plans for a new First Time Buyer Isa.

items.title: Chancellor John Healey delivers steady-as-she-goes maiden budget
items.summary: According to The Guardian, the chancellor has raised taxes modestly and kept deficit plans on track while postponing tough spending decisions to next year.

items.title: Budget 2026: impact on personal finance, mortgages and tax thresholds
items.summary: According to The Guardian, a breakdown of how the chancellor’s measures on tax, benefits, pensions and allowances affect personal finances across different household incomes.

items.title: UK banks face temporary corporation tax surcharge rise to 6% under Budget 2026
items.summary: According to The Guardian, chancellor John Healey has announced a temporary increase in the bank corporation tax surcharge, raising it from 3% to 6% for a 15-month period.

items.title: JD Power study shows total loss auto claims weigh on customer satisfaction
items.summary: According to Insurance Journal, uS customer satisfaction with total loss claims declined for a third consecutive year, while repairable vehicle claims improved.
